preconditions.description: The number of vertices in the graph is between 1 and 10,000.
The number of edges in the graph is between 0 and 10,000.

preconditions.expression: Each node in the graph has a distinct value in the range 0 to V - 1
preconditions.description: Each node in the graph is labeled with a distinct integer in the range 0 to V - 1.

postconditions.description: The output array contains at least one safe node.

postconditions.expression: all(node in output for node in range(V))
postconditions.description: Every node in the graph is either a terminal node or leads to a terminal node, meaning every node is a safe node.
The output array is sorted in ascending order.
